item.title: Insta360 releases x6 360-degree camera with improved image quality and AI editing
item.summary: Insta360 has unveiled its new flagship 360-degree camera – the Insta360 X6 – which has improved image quality, easier shooting and editing and added versatility. The new Insta360 X6 is available now and priced at $1,049.99.
